reproduce_first.note: The ask requests an accessibility feature change, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specifies the controls and keyboard access behaviors to implement.

stack_discovery.note: The steps do not show checking package scripts or the README for project check commands before running checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent added functionality and tests in stages, then ran checks and responded to failures, but some later changes were followed only by final checks.

self_review.note: No step shows the agent reviewing its diff or reasoning through the completed change before reporting done.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup after passing checks followed by rerunning checks is shown.

test_experiment.note: New tests failed during development and prompted debugging, but the steps do not show a deliberate test experiment followed by restoring the change.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The README file list was updated to describe the new buttons and accessibility stylesheet.

scope_kept.note: The touched files and reported changes address the requested keyboard and screen reader accessibility work.

verification_story.note: The done summary lists lint, typecheck, unit and browser test results, but does not say what was checked by hand.

hand_check.note: The new end-to-end browser tests exercised the changed accessible names and keyboard flows in the running app.
